title: Zang International with Lynette Zang: AI Chip Collateral: CoreWeave Debt and Nvidia’s
description:
Original video author: Zang International with Lynette Zang. Independent recap and commentary; no endorsement implied. AI chip collateral raises a debt-risk question in Riley Brewster’s commentary on Zang International with Lynette Zang. We recap CoreWeave’s losses and borrowing, Nvidia’s $2 billion investment and up-to-$6.3 billion capacity agreement through 2032, and the cited $230 billion estimate of broader commitments—not money already spent. Next come USD.AI’s equipment-backed loans, the car-depreciation analogy, possible retirement exposure and Brewster’s case for physical gold and silver.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
